name: salt-ai-pillar-intellisense
description: Offline multi-language IntelliSense for common source files, with SaltStack pillar schema completions, local static analysis and optional local-model completions.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Read-only: completions and validation call a loopback HTTP bridge; no workspace code is executed.

commands.title: AI Pillar: Create Local Bridge Token
AI Pillar: Open Bridge Setup Guide

saltAiPillar.tokenPath.description: Path to the 0600 shared secret read by both the extension and the bridge. A leading ~/ expands to the user's home directory. Workspace settings cannot override it. Use the 'Salt AI: AI Pillar: Create Local Bridge Token' command to generate it explicitly; the extension never creates it on install.

saltAiPillar.eventLogPath.description: Local file for the extension's bounded event log. A leading ~/ expands to the user's home directory.

saltAiPillar.healthResultPath.description: Local file where the Check Bridge Health command writes its JSON result. A leading ~/ expands to the user's home directory.

saltAiPillar.endpoint.description: Local bridge API base URL. Plain HTTP on loopback only; workspace settings cannot override it.

saltAiPillar.languageCompletions.description: Offer offline keyword, function and snippet completions for supported source languages.

saltAiPillar.useAI.description: Also ask the optional local model for a completion. Off by default; offline completions, schema validation and scanning do not need a model.

saltAiPillar.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay before a bridge completion call; newer edits cancel the previous request.

saltAiPillar.timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout. Raise this if useAI is enabled; model speed depends on your hardware.

saltAiPillar.maxTokens.description: Max tokens for the optional AI completion.
